method: Read every hunk of complete 4682-line no-renames model diff for the48paths; inspect full old/new seed path, full endpoint migration and full QuotientCPGIC source; compare existing declaration headers and7moved complete bodies, inspect caller results across4roots. This is source review, not Lean elaboration.
findings: No mathematical blocker found. Outside seed-route replacement and intentional helper availability differences, common declarations retain identical normalized explicit source headers.
Seven declarations moved unchanged including complete bodies, comments/whitespace ignored. The shared FullSeed namespace is retained for lower-chain callers.
Fresh-label construction preserves literal equality. k=enc(th(negNF(negNF psi))) is greater than1; free_th and free_lt_enc show k is not free in the semantic matrix.

th_bundleNF commutes equality interpretation only to establish interpreted-code derivability. Satisfaction of the named bundle comes from hT itself, so no unjustified semantic equality interpretation is used.

named_bundle_iff_seed needs distinct roles and a fresh matrix label; named_req_iff/named_clos_iff explicitly carry the update-distinctness hypotheses. It does not assume irreflexivity. Endpoint separately supplies hirr in FullSeed.
Endpoint migration uses original inhabitant e0, removing the indiscernibility quotient. The later tagged bisimulation quotient and well-founded interpretation remain.

a7b8f1ae67 quotient changes only shorten proof terms; they preserve raw-output guards, literal subset representative construction, arbitrary native Form parameters, and explicit inhabitant. No raw irreflexivity is transported across bisimilarity.

Phase16 twelve unused strong forwarder retirements and sole-caller weak trace inline remain compatible with the frozen main source census. Main retained helpers are original proposal APIs, not new dependencies.
Extra4file candidate removes two sole-caller/duplicate helpers and stale prose without changing endpoint statement or shared FullSeed structure.
risks_and_required_checks: This review does not prove compilation. Fresh combined source closure and API/endpoint axiom profiles are required; phase16 receipts do not apply to changed modules.
Equality transport, inferred implicit arguments, merged tactic branches and concrete declaration identities must be elaborated by Lean. Header comparison cannot detect implicit dependency changes.
The old KSeedModel222/KIndisc222 modules are intentionally absent. Maintained imports migrate; frozen historical evidence must not be rewritten as if old retired-route APIs still compile.
Direct proof needs a typed client for arbitrary named psi and separately a native equality instance or generic FullSeed construction. No EqFree psi premise should be introduced.
Combined quotient source must keep explicit PowerSyntax import in QuotientModel after keeping phase16 trace helper retirement.
